title: Polymarket Hackers Steal $2.7 Million From Traders
excerpt: Malicious code injected into Polymarket via a hijacked script allowed hackers to steal about $2.7 million from 726 user wallets.
body_html:
Attackers recently targeted the prediction market platform Polymarket, making off with approximately $2.7 million in funds from signed-in traders. The incident took place on October 29 after malicious code managed to replace a legitimate page-speed script that the platform loaded from an external company, DebugBear.

During the security breach, the unauthorized code executed commands that sold specific positions held by active traders and transferred their funds directly to the hackers. Blockchain data indicates that cryptocurrency valued at roughly $2.64 million successfully reached the attackers.

Following the breach, Polymarket announced plans to fully reimburse the affected users. The platform is currently issuing refunds totaling around $2.7 million to cover all 726 crypto wallets that suffered losses during the unauthorized exploit.
